def transform(grid):
    """Mark cells that are empty in both side-by-side 4x4 panels."""
    width = len(grid[0])
    split = width // 2
    return [[4 if grid[r][c] == 0 and grid[r][c + split] == 0 else 0
             for c in range(split)]
            for r in range(len(grid))]
PY
